claims.claim: Link prediction formalizes scoring previously unconnected node pairs for future network link formation.
claims.locator: Liben-Nowell and Kleinberg (2007), introduction and link prediction task

claims.claim: Adamic–Adar weights each common neighbor z by 1/log(degree(z)); the score is not a calibrated link probability.
claims.locator: Official NetworkX definition and undirected graph conditions

claims.claim: On the explicit 5-node, 6-edge train graph, CN(A,D)=2, Jaccard=2/3, Adamic–Adar=2/log(3).
claims.locator: Derived from stated graph, set calculations, and NetworkX oracle

claims.claim: Temporal link prediction separates past observed structure from future edge labels to avoid information leakage.
claims.locator: Definition of social network evolution prediction; explicitly specified train/test evaluation convention

claims.claim: Predictions over observed nonedges require documented negative candidates, class proportions and time windows; unobserved edges are not necessarily true negatives.
claims.locator: NetworkX scores are calculated for specified ebunch; evaluation protocol is external to the score

claims.claim: Train/test candidate sets and structural CN scores must exclude future B-D; injecting that future edge changes CN(B,E) from 0 to 1.
claims.locator: OGB train graph and time-based link splits; independent synthetic experiments in v2/tests/test_research_round.py
